about: Retrieval calibration question set (#189 step 3). Each entry is ONE question asked in both languages, with the file(s) that answer it in each corpus. Paired deliberately: the same question in English and Japanese is the only way the two can be compared, because an unrelated pair would differ by subject as well as by language. Answers are a SET where the content genuinely lives in more than one place — a question whose answer is in the book AND a runbook is answered by either, and pretending otherwise would score a correct retrieval as a miss. Authored against the committed docs; `verify` in calibrate-retrieval.rkt checks every path exists before a run.
